title: The Cashflow Quadrant: Earned vs Passive Income Math
hook_text: TRADING HOURS FOR DOLLARS GUARANTEES YOU WORK UNTIL YOU DIE

beats.say: Trading hours for dollars guarantees you work until you die.
beats.visual: Cinematic shot of a desk clock ticking in a dim office, macro lens, moody lighting.

beats.say: Here is the exact mathematical shift to cross the quadrant.
beats.visual: Overhead shot of a blank notepad on a wooden table with a fountain pen resting beside it.

beats.say: Most people stay stuck on the left side as employees or self-employed.
beats.visual: A silhouette of a worker walking down a long concrete hallway toward a single door.

beats.say: You trade time for money, and your taxes take the heaviest drag.
beats.visual: Close-up of hands counting a stack of cash on a dark surface.

beats.say: Why does wealth build on the right side instead?
beats.visual: Cinematic wide shot of a modern glass office building exterior at dusk, soft blur.

beats.say: People assume you need millions to own a business or invest in assets.
beats.visual: A person looking out a large window at a city skyline, backlight, silhouette.

beats.say: The truth is you can start by making your money buy things that pay you back.
beats.visual: Close-up of a hand flipping a metal coin on a wooden desk.

beats.say: Investing $500 a month at 8% reaches $600,000 in 27 years.
beats.visual: Macro shot of a calculator screen reflecting warm ambient light.

beats.say: That is how passive income covers your life expenses.
beats.visual: A steaming ceramic mug sitting on a wooden windowsill with morning light filtering through.

beats.say: The honest catch is that building this takes years of work and capital.
beats.visual: Close-up of a worn leather notebook resting on a desk next to a pair of glasses.

beats.say: Leverage cuts both ways, and real estate needs repairs and tenants.
beats.visual: Cinematic slow pan across an empty room with soft shadows on the wall.

beats.say: Learn the rules, build your assets, and shift your cash flow.
beats.visual: A person walking out into bright daylight, silhouette from behind.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: Close-up of a wooden front door opening to warm morning light.
